seo.title: Calculator: how much will I receive in reais? | Travessia
seo.description: Type the invoice amount in dollars, euros or pounds and see how much arrives in reais, with the 0.6% fee and the example rate.

examples.title: Three examples, line by line
examples.lead: Example rates: {rates}. The fee is always {fee} of the amount converted.
examples.caption: Conversion examples

notes.title: The fee
notes.text: 0.6% of the amount you convert. Receiving and holding a balance cost nothing.

notes.title: The rate
notes.text: The commercial rate at that moment, with no hidden margin. You see the amount before you confirm.

notes.title: The timing
notes.text: Conversions confirmed by 4 pm reach your Pix on the next business day.
